title: arcgisviz
text: R package binding ArcGIS Maps SDK Charts capabilities (@arcgis/charts-components). Two halves: S7 type layer R mirrors JS chart config JSON shape, htmlwidget renders <arcgis-chart> browser config plus data source. Source truth types @arcgis/charts-components’s bundled spec, separate package. @arcgis/charts-model/@arcgis/charts-spec (packages project originally generated types ) independent, stalled version line (4.32.15, latest published, newer release) diverged @arcgis/charts-components (tracking SDK 5.1.x) actually ships runs - confirmed real divergence (subTitle renamed subtitle, WebChartScatterPlotSeries renamed WebChartScatterplotSeries, temporal binning restructured, etc). packages removed package.json/node_modules reason. Read types : - node_modules/@arcgis/charts-components/dist/spec/web-chart.d.ts - WebChart config shape (WebChart*/series/axis/query interfaces, one file). - .../dist/spec/chart-object-literals.d.ts - WebChart* enums (const objects + derived types). - .../dist/spec/rest-js-types.d.ts - Color, IFont, ISimpleFillSymbol/ ISimpleLineSymbol/ISimpleMarkerSymbol/ITextSymbol, IStatisticDefinition. - .../dist/spec/rest-js-object-literals.d.ts - RESTUnits REST-prefixed symbol-style consts (mostly unused directly - non-REST-prefixed versions rest-js-types.d.ts properties actually reference). - .../dist/spec/data-source.d.ts - TimeIntervalInfo, RGBObject. JSON Schema anymore - @arcgis/charts-components ships .d.ts declarations, runtime-extractable schema object (checked; worth re-deriving one). data-raw/resolve-spec-types.R data-raw/spec-type-registry.json (old JSON-Schema-driven pipeline) stale/archival - don’t treat current, don’t mechanically regenerate R/types-*.R/R/enums-*.R . Types now hand-written directly .d.ts files , imperative-API data-raw/<model>.json docs always (separately stale - came removed @arcgis/charts-model package’s method-level .d.ts files, describing createModel()/JS-wiring path, current work - see arcgis-js-widget skill).

text: Bar chart, scatterplot, line chart (incl. combo bar-line, needs zero new code since WebChart$series untyped class_list) complete S7 type stacks (config classes + enums), rebuilt @arcgis/charts-components’s bundled spec (see ) verified construct end--end realistic, minimally-specified data (see tests/testthat/test-type-defaults.R). top sits public API exposes S7 objects (R/arc-chart.R: arc_chart() |> set_type() |> set_x() |> set_y(), plus arc_bar()/arc_scatter()/arc_line() sugar, tidy-eval bare column names, friendly kebab-case type names) data -transfer layer (R/arc-data.R) turns data frame + config widget payload. Box plot, pie, gauge, histogram, radar chart types yet modeled.

title: arcgisviz
text: s7x::to_json(x, ..., pretty = FALSE) works S7 config class package - ’s as_vector(x) + yyjsonr::write_json_str(auto_unbox = TRUE), generic S7_object method s7x. as_vector() single extension point wire format. recurses generic (as_vector_value(), s7x/R/as_vector.R:30), method nested class fires parent’s walk. R/arc-data.R registers three, to_json() inherits free: WebChart - drops unset (NA/NULL) properties via compact_config(). three WebChart*Series classes - emit query: null query unset, client-side signal delete default. Color - spec’s raw [r,g,b,] tuple, undoing package’s deliberate r/g/b/exception. partly-specified color returns NULL drops . Two mechanics depends : S7::super(x, S7::S7_object) reach default method override (otherwise infinite recursion), .onLoad()’s S7::methods_register() R/zzz.R - without , methods another package’s generic registered build time lost install. S7::method(s7x::as_vector, X) <- f work (replacement form assign back ::), hence @importFrom s7x as_vector. from_json() (JSON -> S7 object) doesn’t exist yet - harder problem, needs know class construct .

title: arcgisviz
text: R/arc-data.R builds createModel() payload; header comment cites exact @arcgis/charts-components dist files/functions rule comes , tests/testthat/test-data-transfer.R asserts shapes. non-obvious parts: createModel() called twice, R sends chartType config. sparse config can’t go createModel() alone - WebChart needs full axes/labels/symbol tree engine throws “X axes chart” - getDefault*Chart() needs CommonStrings localization bundle can’t construct. : createModel({ iLayer, chartType }) harvests model’s defaults, deepMerge() layers R’s sparse config defaults.config, createModel({ iLayer, config }) builds real model complete config. Assigning model.config post-setup instead re-adds series axes fails. deepMerge() treats null delete, value. ’s R’s way unset one model’s defaults, since absent key just leaves default place. stat = "identity" needs : default bar/line series ships count aggregation ($e(), dist/chunks/index.js) BarAndLineNoAggregation requires query.outStatistics undefined (ga(), dist/chunks/index2.js:593). Aggregation stat, maps 1:1 onto ggplot2’s. ga() picks bar/line subtype purely query shape: outStatistics -> BarAndLineNoAggregation (geom_col(), stat = "identity"); groupByFieldsForStatistics + outStatistics -> BarAndLineMonoField (geom_bar()/stat_summary()). aggregation series’ y must name outStatisticFieldName, source column - ArcChart holds mapping (x/y/stat) @webchart computed getter (build_webchart()), stored, eagerly-mutated object. iLayer needs layerType = "ArcGISFeatureLayer" carries data featureCollection$layers[[1]]$featureSet / $layerDefinition. converter (gi, dist/chunks/index2.js) reads paths plus fields/objectIdField/geometryType/spatialReference - precisely arcgisutils::as_feature_collection() emits. Unset properties must dropped, sent JSON null - default as_vector() method materializes every property (16 WebChart’s 20 top-level ones NA/NULL minimal chart), explicit null override default instead falling back . See “Serialization” : Color tuple conversion as_vector() methods, bespoke pass. serialize widget payload . widget sets attr(x, "TOJSON_FUNC") <- widget_json, htmlwidgets’ documented hook replacing serializer outright, nothing depends htmlwidgets’/jsonlite’s defaults. widget_json() yyjsonr-based (engine s7x::to_json()), yyjsonr’s defaults correct ones jsonlite’s : dataframe = "rows" (jsonlite defaults “columns”, silently breaks layerDefinition$fields - JS fields.map(Field.fromJSON) needs array objects) str_specials/num_specials = "null" NA. Prefer serialization host package’s wherever option exists. htmlwidgets hands function whole payload (x, evals, jsHooks), just x, expects JSON string back. Single-shot : whole collection goes one payload. arcgisutils::as_esri_features() per-feature JSON future batched path stream (cf. SDK’s large-collection sample, via applyEdits() live layer), nothing needs yet.

Don’t model live-layer types. Geometry types (IPoint/IPolygon/etc.) - handled elsewhere, modeled package’s type registry. WebChartDataFilters$geometry stays class_any. chart types’ series shapes (pie, gauge, histogram, box plot, radar, heat) - web-chart.d.ts one file now (per-chart-type .d.ts sprawl resolve), adding one just reading relevant interface(s) following arcgis-spec-types skill’s conventions - fundamentally blocked anything, just done yet.

what: R style: rlang first, cli for all messaging
title: arcgisviz
text: Reach rlang base R, always. rlang::is_null() .null(), rlang::is_empty() length(x) == 0, rlang::is_list()/is_atomic()/is_scalar_character() .*() equivalents, rlang::arg_match0() match.arg(). Reference: https://rlang.r-lib.org/llms.txt. Every user-facing condition message goes cli - cli::cli_abort(), cli::cli_warn(), cli::cli_inform(). Never stop(), warning(), message(), paste0()-built strings. Use inline markup ({.arg x}, {.field {col}}, {.val {x}}, {.fn set_type}), pluralize {?s}, pass call = call call = rlang::caller_env() argument errors point user’s frame. Load r-lib:cli skill writing .

what: Conventions worth knowing before editing R/
title: arcgisviz
text: S7 classes: Foo := new_class(properties = list(...)) - name string first arg (breaks :=’s inference, silently binds parent instead errors). s7x:: always fully-qualified package code. Optional properties: NA already satisfies s7x::class_string/ class_double/class_boolean/Enum (allow_na = TRUE) - wrapping needed, including property simply omitted constructor call (verified tests/testthat/test-type-defaults.R; used false broke omission round s7x fixes new_enum()/property_scalar()/property_range()/property_union() default-value handling). optional object-typed properties need s7x::property_union(Type, NULL, default = NULL) - literal NULL really respected omission now (property_union() used conflate “default arg supplied” “default = NULL supplied explicitly” deep-default Type instead; fixed). Color (R/color.R) r/g/b/(four class_double), raw [r,g,b,] tuple spec uses - deliberate exception, keep . DESCRIPTION’s Collate: field load-bearing - R/ files real cross-file dependencies. Add new files dependency order load_all() breaks “object found”. writing/editing S7 class, diff property names relevant @arcgis/charts-components .d.ts interface hand (see “Source truth” ) - data-raw/spec-type-registry.json stale, don’t diff anymore. roxygen2 doesn’t recognize := assignment operator, bare #' @export Foo := new_class(...) silently dropped - NAMESPACE entry, Rd file, error. Every :=-defined class needs explicit #' @name Foo (least one-line title) alongside @export never gets exported. Run just document twice adding new cross-references doc blocks ([Foo()] links) - first devtools::document() pass can report stale “resolve link” warning topic documented run; clears second pass new Rd file disk.

title: arcgisviz
text: Never write/run ad-hoc inline scripts (python -c, node -e, etc.) file operations data manipulation, even read-checks - project burned . Data-generating R scripts live data-raw/ real files, reviewed, run R -q -f data-raw/whatever.R. One-R -q -e inspection/verification snippets fine.
